posts.title: The Apps I Use as a Professional Writer
posts.description: Here are the apps I use most often as a professional writer. I’m not including any “business” apps here, just the ones that help me get words out into the world. IA Writer This app is expensive, but has been worth every penny. Something about the interface just makes the process of putting words on the page truly enjoyable. posts.description: I spent a weird amount of time assigning a Taylor Swift song to all of my books. It was hard work. Vital work.
